summary_1line: Draupadi laments her humiliation in Virata’s court; Bhima vows restrained vengeance and urges patience until exile ends while hearing of Kichaka’s harassment.

image_candidates.scene_text: Draupadi silently weeps while showing Bhima her once-soft hands now rough and covered with corns from servitude.
Bhima clasps Draupadi’s calloused hands and weeps, his huge warrior frame bent in grief and restrained fury.
Kichaka confronts Draupadi in his chambers as she stands defiant, warning him that her five Gandharva husbands will destroy him.
